scope: Initial review and input preparation were local-only. Later explicitly authorized exact-source related Linux gates are separately bound here; no device changes or performance timing by reviewer.
semantic_review: The shortcut admits only ordinary well-formed-header IN A/AAAA with no configured CNAME, matching raw address type, interface declarations/records, synthesis domain or local-address/local-only rule. Anything uncertain reaches the unchanged original body.

Hosts must be published and name_exists must be false. This includes canonical owner and non-terminal presence checks; active/sealed bulk generations keep retained-lease lookup and rotation in the original engine.
has_expired_name covers both active expired lease entries and expired non-terminals. It rejects the shortcut before the original expire_name mutation, preserving sticky deletion under clock rollback.
Any live lease blocks the shortcut, including an IPv4 lease queried as AAAA. This is conservative; it does not invent an AAAA local answer.

Before returning None, cache.inspect_name runs with the same question Name object and stores its hint. Cached CNAME inspection is read-only and continues to defer local output to the later cache engine; no local/CNAME precedence is bypassed.
The shortcut has no address to rotate and no local answer/log event to emit. Source and local-only rule guards retain the original query logging and configured-answer ownership paths.

Normal header gates match the original LocalAnswerer rejection boundary. For a consistent parsed question/query, malformed Additional records are treated as no OPT by the existing find_pseudoheader, rather than errors.

review_hypothesis_retracted.initial_claim: Reviewer inferred that filterwin2k plus ARCOUNT1 with a missing Additional RR would return Err in the original path but None in the shortcut.
review_hypothesis_retracted.resolution: This claim was false: find_pseudoheader catches truncated Additional parsing and returns Ok with no OPT. The first author reproduction failed because reference.is_err was false; the uncommitted conservative filterwin2k guard was removed.
review_hypothesis_retracted.corrected_test: Both A/AAAA and UDP/TCP yield None on both original and shortcut paths with the malformed Additional. No production fix was required.

tests.matrix: 10 configurations x5 names x2 address types x2 transports x3 clock values.
tests.additional_stateful_checks: The same lease generation is queried at160 then100; expired name remains removed. Bulk state rejects the shortcut.

local_allocation_evidence.scope: Retained30-row/15-scene local allocation diagnostic, not A53 or timing; independently checked34 successful command log hashes and row arithmetic.
local_allocation_evidence.interpretation: Four hit cases, both misses, raw/synth addresses, RRset and configured/lease CNAME rows are allocation-neutral here. host,host-localise,lease-address and ordinary cname each add1 alloc/op. host-localise also differs by0.02 realloc/op and63.16 requested bytes/op; retain this measured difference without attributing it solely to one allocation site.

prepared_linux_inputs.status: Prepared exact source uploaded after explicit release; related Linux gates passed, original manifest unchanged.
gates: original lib ignored-live excluding four complete exact-C oracle drivers

limitations: The conservative test can add an extra dotted-name allocation/check on a fallback. The observed cold-path costs remain part of the candidate tradeoff.
